contracts.name: NLA.SP15.box_scalar_certificate
contracts.header:
theorem box_scalar_certificate :
    0 < boxRadius ∧ 0 < 1 - boxRadius ∧ 0 < 1 - 2 * boxRadius ∧
    3 * (1 + boxRadius) < 4 - boxRadius ∧
    (4 - boxRadius) - 3 * (1 + boxRadius) = (3 / 4 : ℝ)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.parameter_box_geometry
contracts.header: theorem parameter_box_geometry : IsOpen parameterBox ∧ basePoint ∈ parameterBox

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.parameter_box_bounds
contracts.header:
theorem parameter_box_bounds (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, 0 < pCoordinates x i) ∧ 0 < x 6 ∧ 0 < x 7 ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 3,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖qMatrix x i j‖) + 3 / 4 < (qMatrix x i i).re

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.p_intervals_separate
contracts.header:
theorem p_intervals_separate (x y : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox)
    (hy : y ∈ parameterBox) (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pCoordinates x i ≠ pCoordinates y j

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.parameter_matrices_positive
contracts.header:
theorem parameter_matrices_positive (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) :
    (pMatrix x).PosDef ∧ (qMatrix x).PosDef

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.square_root_semantics
contracts.header:
theorem square_root_semantics (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) :
    (pRoot x).IsHermitian ∧ (qRoot x).IsHermitian ∧
    pRoot x * pRoot x = pMatrix x ∧ qRoot x * qRoot x = qMatrix x ∧
    IsUnit (pRoot x) ∧ IsUnit (qRoot x)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.coefficient_determinant_identity
contracts.header:
theorem coefficient_determinant_identity (x : Parameters) (u s : ℂ) :
    coefficientDeterminant x u s =
      u ^ 3 + ∑ i : Fin 9, (coefficients x i : ℂ) * coefficientMonomials u s i

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.coefficient_base_value
contracts.header: theorem coefficient_base_value : coefficients basePoint = coefficientBaseValue

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.coefficient_strict_derivative
contracts.header:
theorem coefficient_strict_derivative :
    HasStrictFDerivAt coefficients coefficientDerivative basePoint

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.jacobian_lu_certificate
contracts.header:
theorem jacobian_lu_certificate :
    jacobianMinor = lowerCertificate * upperCertificate ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 9, i < j → lowerCertificate i j = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 9, lowerCertificate i i = 1) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 9, j < i → upperCertificate i j = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 9, upperCertificate i i ≠ 0) ∧
    (∏ i : Fin 9, upperCertificate i i) = (-1088 : ℝ)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.jacobian_minor_nonsingular
contracts.header: theorem jacobian_minor_nonsingular : jacobianMinor.det = (-1088 : ℝ)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.augmented_strict_derivative
contracts.header:
theorem augmented_strict_derivative :
    HasStrictFDerivAt augmented augmentedDerivative basePoint

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.augmented_derivative_equivalence
contracts.header:
theorem augmented_derivative_equivalence :
    ∃ e : Parameters ≃L[ℝ] Parameters,
      (e : Parameters →L[ℝ] Parameters) = augmentedDerivative

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.local_augmented_inverse
contracts.header:
theorem local_augmented_inverse :
    ∃ g : Parameters → Parameters,
      ContinuousAt g (augmented basePoint) ∧ g (augmented basePoint) = basePoint ∧
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (augmented basePoint),
        g y ∈ parameterBox ∧ augmented (g y) = y

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.local_coefficient_fiber
contracts.header:
theorem local_coefficient_fiber :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ ψ : ℝ → Parameters,
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t - 1| < ε →
        ψ t ∈ parameterBox ∧ coefficients (ψ t) = coefficients basePoint ∧ ψ t 9 = t

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.regularized_gram_blocks
contracts.header:
theorem regularized_gram_blocks (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox)
    (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    Matrix.reindex blockEquiv blockEquiv (regularizedGramBlocks x z t) =
      (t : ℂ) • (1 : Square 9) + shiftedGram (constructedMatrix x) z

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.schur_positive_blocks
contracts.header:
theorem schur_positive_blocks (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox)
    (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 < shiftScalar z t ∧
    (((shiftScalar z t : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Square 3)).PosDef ∧
    (schurPivot x z t).PosDef

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.shifted_gram_determinant
contracts.header:
theorem shifted_gram_determinant (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox)
    (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Matrix.det ((t : ℂ) • (1 : Square 9) + shiftedGram (constructedMatrix x) z) =
      (t : ℂ) ^ 3 * coefficientDeterminant x
        ((shiftScalar z t ^ 3 / t : ℝ) : ℂ) ((shiftScalar z t : ℝ) : ℂ)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.equal_coefficients_gram_charpoly
contracts.header:
theorem equal_coefficients_gram_charpoly (x y : Parameters)
    (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) (hy : y ∈ parameterBox)
    (hxy : coefficients x = coefficients y) (z : ℂ) :
    (shiftedGram (constructedMatrix x) z).charpoly =
      (shiftedGram (constructedMatrix y) z).charpoly

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.gram_charpoly_singular_values
contracts.header:
theorem gram_charpoly_singular_values {n : ℕ} (A B : Square n)
    (h : (A.conjTranspose * A).charpoly = (B.conjTranspose * B).charpoly) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValue A k = singularValue B k

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.equal_coefficients_shifted_singular_values
contracts.header:
theorem equal_coefficients_shifted_singular_values (x y : Parameters)
    (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) (hy : y ∈ parameterBox)
    (hxy : coefficients x = coefficients y) :
    SuperIdentical (constructedMatrix x) (constructedMatrix y)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.constructed_kernel_flag
contracts.header:
theorem constructed_kernel_flag (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) :
    (∀ v : BlockIndex → ℂ,
      (blockMatrix x).mulVec v = 0 ↔
        (∀ i : Fin 3, v (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) = 0) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 3, v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)) = 0)) ∧
    (∀ v : BlockIndex → ℂ,
      (blockMatrix x ^ 2).mulVec v = 0 ↔
        ∀ i : Fin 3, v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)) = 0)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.unitary_intertwiner_blocks
contracts.header:
theorem unitary_intertwiner_blocks (x y : Parameters)
    (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) (hy : y ∈ parameterBox) (U : Square 9)
    (hU : U.conjTranspose * U = 1)
    (hA : constructedMatrix y = U.conjTranspose * constructedMatrix x * U) :
    ∃ U₁ U₂ U₃ : Square 3,
      U₁.conjTranspose * U₁ = 1 ∧ U₂.conjTranspose * U₂ = 1 ∧
      U₃.conjTranspose * U₃ = 1 ∧ U = diagonalBlocks U₁ U₂ U₃ ∧
      pRoot y = U₁.conjTranspose * pRoot x * U₂ ∧
      qRoot y = U₂.conjTranspose * qRoot x * U₃

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.middle_block_conjugacy
contracts.header:
theorem middle_block_conjugacy (x y : Parameters)
    (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) (hy : y ∈ parameterBox)
    (h : UnitarySimilar (constructedMatrix x) (constructedMatrix y)) :
    ∃ V : Square 3, V.conjTranspose * V = 1 ∧
      pMatrix y = V.conjTranspose * pMatrix x * V ∧
      qMatrix y = V.conjTranspose * qMatrix x * V

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.parameter_slice_rigidity
contracts.header:
theorem parameter_slice_rigidity (x y : Parameters)
    (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) (hy : y ∈ parameterBox) (V : Square 3)
    (hV : V.conjTranspose * V = 1)
    (hP : pMatrix y = V.conjTranspose * pMatrix x * V)
    (hQ : qMatrix y = V.conjTranspose * qMatrix x * V) : x = y

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.constructed_unitary_injectivity
contracts.header:
theorem constructed_unitary_injectivity (x y : Parameters)
    (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) (hy : y ∈ parameterBox)
    (h : UnitarySimilar (constructedMatrix x) (constructedMatrix y)) : x = y

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.finite_fiber_selection
contracts.header:
theorem finite_fiber_selection (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ x : Fin (M + 1) → Parameters, Function.Injective x ∧
      (∀ i, x i ∈ parameterBox) ∧ (∀ i, coefficients (x i) = coefficientBaseValue)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.arbitrary_finite_counterfamilies
contracts.header:
theorem arbitrary_finite_counterfamilies (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : Fin (M + 1) → Square 9,
      (∀ i j, SuperIdentical (A i) (A j)) ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin (M + 1), i < j → ¬ UnitarySimilar (A i) (A j)

contracts.name: NLA.SP15.canonical_finiteness_false
contracts.header: theorem canonical_finiteness_false : ¬ CanonicalFiniteness
